verdict.rationale: All MCP evidence (qodo-docs-6, qodo-probe-3, qodo-probe-rt-1) describes Qodo exposing its own MCP server so external coding agents can call Qodo's tools — the reverse direction from this story, which asks whether Qodo itself can consume external MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows Qodo acting as an MCP client that plugs in third-party MCP servers.
